name: hud_ui_options_panel_music_enable_sync_from_options
description: HudUiOptionsPanel_MusicEnable::SyncFromOptions reads the CD-audio option and applies it to the music-enable check toggle.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HUD options-panel source-file/table cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40cc60 calls zSnd::GetCDAudioOption and passes its result directly to HudUiCheckToggleWidget::SetChecked.
Native smoke zhud_options_panel_music_enable_sync_from_options_smoke installs the CD-audio option pointer, verifies option value 1 sets the music-enable toggle, and verifies option value 0 clears it.
